versions.changelog: Cross-link the Exo suite (entry skill `exo-suite-linkage`: literature → experiments → proofs, cost tiers low → medium → high) · pin `uvx` launch versions (rug-pull hygiene; `uvx` otherwise reuses an installed tool env and can run an older release).
install paths completed: uvx --from (package and entry point differ) + pipx, all forms run and verified

refresh to the 0.7 generation: version floor >=0.7.0, uv install paths, Hermes Agent / MCP environment section, the experiment-loop command groups (dispatch / iterate / repeat / hypothesis), top-level tags for ClawHub categorisation, and explicit development-line features that are not in the 0.7.0 artifact

- Initial public release of experiment-lifecycle-governance, providing experiment workflow governance features.
- Adds PIN-protected guard for destructive operations (cancel, stop, delete).
- Introduces standardized metrics registry with thresholds for consistent experiment reporting.
- Supports multi-model experiment ranking and scoring with gating based on metric thresholds.
- Implements an audit tool to validate compliance with competition rules using experiment metrics and parameters.
- Includes detailed CLI and Python API, error handling, edge-case testing, and guidance on secure PIN management.
